Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring a revote if the number of ballots counted and voters credited with voting cannot be reconciled.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to election certification; and adding a new sectionto chapter 29A.60 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 29A.60 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Before final certification of election returns, the county mustreport and explain, by precinct, any variance between the number ofballots counted and the number of voters credited with voting. If there are differences between the number of ballots counted andthe number of voters credited with voting that cannot be explained, andthat difference exceeds the winning margin in any election or primary,the election or primary as to that election is void. No certificate ofelection may be issued. A revote of that election must be held withinsixty days.
